title: Classist Tools: Social Class Correlates with Performance in NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring performance disparities in automated speech recognition (Word Error Rate), language modeling (perplexity), and grammar error correction (edit frequency) across utterances annotated for different socioeconomic strata (Lower, Middle, Upper class) from movie and TV show transcripts.
Comparing automated speech recognition error rates and language model perplexities between utterances from predominantly Black versus predominantly White characters in television shows.

Evaluating language model perplexity and grammar error correction rates across different English geographical language varieties, specifically comparing US versus UK dialects and regional variations within the UK.
